description: S7: Minimum C0 safety profile for apps_rg resume shipping. Defines required FEC fields, support status promotion rules, briefing authority/freshness policy, and no-company-research-lane invariant.

grounding_required_policy.note: C0 must be required before PA when grounding_required=true. Bypass is never silent PASS.

support_status.note: Missing support_status is treated as UNKNOWN, never PASS

final_evidence_digest.note: Empty digest breaks provenance chain — WARN not hard FAIL for file-only path

source_lineage_map.note: Required when Chroma active; WARN when file-only

freshness_receipts.note: Required per source when freshness class declared; WARN when absent

acl_verification_receipts.note: Required per source when ACL check declared; WARN when absent

contradiction_report.note: WARN when absent and no not_applicable_reason; NOT_APPLICABLE allowed with reason

citation_map.note: WARN when Chroma active and absent; OK for file-only path

PASS.note: PASS may remain PASS only if required evidence fields are present

PARTIAL.note: PARTIAL is a passing status per FEC contract

WEAK_WITH_CAVEATS.note: WEAK_WITH_CAVEATS must NOT be promoted to PASS

WEAK.note: WEAK must NOT be promoted to PASS

UNKNOWN.note: UNKNOWN is NEVER PASS. Missing support_status defaults to UNKNOWN.

missing.note: Missing support_status is treated as UNKNOWN, not PASS

briefing_policy.note: Stale or unauthorized briefing can never become a clean PASS

company_research_lane.note: apps_rg C0 handles candidate-owned facts, JD/resume grounding, per-section support only. No company research retrieval inside apps_rg C0.

safe_to_continue_to_pa_rules.note: safe_to_continue_to_pa=true requires overall verdict PASS or WARN. FAIL/BLOCKED/UNKNOWN blocks PA.
